title: Rational left scalar composition from ring-stage data
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Padic l, a finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, finite-type quasi-compact D.k-schemes X and Y, and a separated finite-type quasi-compact D.k-morphism f : X → Y. Let A be RingStageAssembly l Ω D hl for f [def-sf-ring-stage-assembly-data], and P a RationalStageAssembly over A [lem-sf-rational-stage-localization]. No absolute separatedness is assumed. For every compactification c of f, finite coefficient fields E,L,M, embeddings i:E→L and j:L→M over Padic l, and rational constructible K on X over E, the composite of P.scalar(c,E,L,i).q extended to M, P.scalar(c,L,M,j).q, and the image under P.operation(c,M).F of the published rational scalar associator equals the target scalar associator followed by P.scalar(c,E,M,j.comp i).q. The equality is on the actual rational categories and uses exactly the supplied operations and scalar maps.

source.place: Construction 6.6, common-field descent step 1: normalized left scalar composition; adapt the proved NormalizedRationalLeftComposition proof to the supplied ring and rational records without any closed operation.

proof.text: Residue Tor puts every integral constructible object in the finite-Tor subcategory, so every rational object is literally the rationalization of an integral object. Identify the localized scalar functors from their object and pure-tensor map specifications.

Apply the normalized ring compact-support scalar cocycle to A.scalar and A.comparison. Its normalized realization identifies the integral q maps with the proper/open compact-support maps. Transport its balanced associator through normalized_scalar_associator_localization.

On an integral representative P.scalar_normalized identifies both rational q composites with the localization of the preceding integral equation. P.action identifies the image of the integral associator. Functoriality of rationalization and the endpoint object equalities yield the claimed equation; surjectivity gives every K.

theorem ring_stage_rational_left_composition (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (R : RingStageAssembly.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (F : RationalStageAssembly.{u, v} l Ω D hl R) :
    ∀ (c : Compactification f) (E L M : FieldStage.{max u v} l)
      (i : E.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] L.carrier) (j : L.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] M.carrier)
      (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.rational E)),
      (rationalScalar.{u, v} l Ω L M j Y).map
          ((F.scalar c E L i).q.hom.app K) ≫
        (F.scalar c L M j).q.hom.app
          ((rationalScalar.{u, v} l Ω E L i X).obj K) ≫
        (F.operation c M).F.map
          ((sfRationalScalarComp l E.carrier L.carrier i X 0
            (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero M.carrier j).hom.app K) =
      (sfRationalScalarComp l E.carrier L.carrier i Y 0
        (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero M.carrier j).hom.app
          ((F.operation c E).F.obj K) ≫
        (F.scalar c E M (j.comp i)).q.hom.app K
